# Hackster.io

> > The world's largest community for learning hardware, with 2.5M+ members sharing 43K+ open source projects across Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and IoT platforms.

Hackster.io connects makers, engineers, and hardware enthusiasts with tutorials, project guides, and platform-specific resources from major manufacturers like Adafruit, Arduino, Espressif, AMD, and Xilinx. The community features beginner-friendly guides, advanced FPGA programming, IoT solutions, and BLE development across diverse hardware ecosystems.

## Key Topics

- Arduino IDE
- ESP32/ESP8266
- IoT (Internet of Things)
- Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
- Maker Community
- Adafruit
- Xilinx FPGA
- AMD Hardware
- Raspberry Pi
- Hardware Projects
- Open Source Hardware
- Embedded Systems
- Beginner Guides
- Development Boards
- LoRa/LoRaWAN

## Core Platform Pages

- [Hackster.io Homepage](https://hackster.io): Homepage featuring Arduino UNO Q contest and hardware learning community
- [What is Hackster.io?](https://hackster.io/about): About page: 2.5M+ members, 43K+ open source hardware projects worldwide
- [Hackster Store](https://store.hackster.io): E-commerce store for Hackster hardware products and development boards

## Major Hardware Platforms

- [Espressif Projects (ESP32/ESP8266)](https://hackster.io/Espressif/projects): Espressif platform: 2,913 ESP32/ESP8266 wireless embedded projects
- [AWS IoT Platform](https://hackster.io/AmazonWebServices): AWS platform page for connected devices and IoT cloud services
- [AMD Hardware Projects](https://hackster.io/AMD/projects): AMD platform page featuring 961 hardware projects and tutorials
- [Punch Through BLE (Bean)](https://bean.hackster.io): Punch Through's BLE development boards (Bean, Bean+, LightBlue Bean)

## IoT & Embedded Systems Projects

- [Smart Water Meter (ESP32)](https://hackster.io/Pedro52/smart-water-meter-58d99d): ESP32 smart water meter with inductive sensor and Blynk IoT integration
- [Smart Farming Gateway (Android Things)](https://hackster.io/agrhub/smart-farming-gateway-based-on-android-things-dd3b54): AGRHUB's Android Things IoT gateway project for agricultural monitoring
- [RAKwireless RUI3 Programming Guide](https://hackster.io/alveiroRakwireless/learn-about-the-new-way-of-programming-iot-rui3-b4947a): Tutorial on RAKwireless RUI3 programming with WisBlock and LoRa P2P

## Microcontroller & FPGA Tutorials

- [STM32L476 Digital Clock with RTC](https://hackster.io/avinash-kumar-pathak/digital-clock-using-internal-rtc-of-stm32l476-c141b3): STM32L476 digital clock tutorial using internal RTC and LCD display
- [PetaLinux FPGA Programming Guide](https://hackster.io/anujvaishnav20/programming-the-pl-at-runtime-with-petalinux-72a820): PetaLinux guide for runtime FPGA programming on Zynq/Ultra96
- [Arduino 1Sheeld Robot Car](https://hackster.io/13766/super-easy-to-build-1sheeld-2-wheel-drive-robot-cb9b66): Beginner guide: 1Sheeld Arduino RC robot car with Bluetooth control
